# Recurrence Rule

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:RecurrenceRule`](gmeow-RecurrenceRule.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/RecurrenceRule>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A rule by which a [`gmeow:EventSeries`](gmeow-EventSeries.md) repeats — weekly, every-first-Monday, annually. Carries an RFC 5545 RRULE string via [`gmeow:recurrenceRuleText`](../properties/gmeow-recurrenceRuleText.md). (= ISO-TimeML TIMEX3 type=SET with freq/quant, iCalendar RRULE, [schema:Schedule](https://schema.org/Schedule), TEO periodic time interval.)

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:RecurrenceRule`](gmeow-RecurrenceRule.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Recurring Meeting

- **Source:** [`slices/core/calendar/examples/recurring-meeting.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/calendar/examples/recurring-meeting.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-calendar-examples-recurring-meeting)#example-slices-core-calendar-examples-recurring-meeting

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: a recurring meeting with invitations. A gmeow:EventSchedule
# repeats a TEMPLATE event by a gmeow:RecurrenceRule (an RFC 5545 RRULE string),
# all anchored in an explicit gmeow:TimeZone (IANA id) — so "every Monday 09:00"
# is unambiguous across DST. Invitations are reified gmeow:EventInvitations
# carrying both the organiser-side gmeow:invitationStatus and the invitee's own
# gmeow:rsvpStatus. The event's kind is an open vocabulary: there is no seed
# "meeting" EventType, so one is minted (the custom-value idiom, P9).
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/calendar/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

ex:weekly a gmeow:RecurrenceRule ;
    gmeow:recurrenceRuleText "FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO" .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the rule by which a [`gmeow:EventSeries`](gmeow-EventSeries.md) repeats — weekly, every-first-Monday, annually — carrying an RFC 5545 RRULE string.

### Avoid when

- Avoid attaching it to a single [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md) occurrence (the rule belongs to the series), and avoid authoring rich recurrence structure in core — the RRULE string is the source, richer form is a projection concern.

### How to use

- Mint a [`gmeow:RecurrenceRule`](gmeow-RecurrenceRule.md) with an RFC 5545 string on [`gmeow:recurrenceRuleText`](../properties/gmeow-recurrenceRuleText.md) and link it from the series via [`gmeow:hasRecurrenceRule`](../properties/gmeow-hasRecurrenceRule.md); projectors emit iCalendar RRULE directly.

### Examples

- ex:weeklyMon a [`gmeow:RecurrenceRule`](gmeow-RecurrenceRule.md); [`gmeow:recurrenceRuleText`](../properties/gmeow-recurrenceRuleText.md) "FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO".
